works.body:
Dear kaseg!

I am a V-liver Emu Chain door management.
My name is Jishugama.
I was introduced to you by a friend and saw your wonderful illustration.
We would be very happy to work with you.

Character
Emu Chido
Her character is a Yandere mine-doem.
For a standing picture, please see the Emu Chained Door uniform on Google Drive.

We have prepared a composition reference for kaseg!i on Google Drive.
I would like a composition of you sitting on a book or a chair in Alice in Wonderland style clothing.
The way she is sitting can be either as shown in the composition reference or in front.
The face should be facing forward, and the eyes and mouth should be open with a smile.
You can either arrange the hair style or choose one from the standing picture.

We would like to use the image as a thumbnail in our distribution, as a return gift, on Twitter, etc.

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PrXM1eAfJWnsfb58DGm8YqGflf5q-WLt?usp=sharing
